label: Gala

provenance.incarnation: MG2 revised official released-port Master Miller: adult survival instructor, swept-back blond hair tied in ponytail, dark aviator sunglasses, lean long face, two intact arms and legs. No Peace Walker uniform, no Phantom Pain amputation or blind-eye appearance. Original CQC gala outfit; no official retail gala costume claimed.

sources.scope: Physically viewed official original-incarnation identity reference. Gala garments and combat motion are authored CQC adaptations; unseen original full-body garments are not certified.
